findings.finding: Q3 production was pre-released at 4,298 bopd net (down 15% q/q, efficiency 90%) with only preliminary September allocations, so the release can only revise it at the margin.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Production pre-releases land a month before results; Q3 2025 results day (also pre-released) moved +0.19%, Q2 2026 -1.45%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: the number was published 9 Oct and the stock traded 12.08-13.28 NOK afterwards. Only a revision of the preliminary September allocation is unpriced, which is small.

findings.finding: No entitlement oil was lifted in Q3 and the company guided no further sales in 2026, so Q3 revenue and operating cash flow will collapse from Q2's USD 151m/112m sale quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last no-lifting quarter (Q1 2026, 29 May) coincided with the NOK 3.25 ex-distribution day, so the baseline's -27.5% is mostly the distribution (about -5% residual); Q1 2025-style no-lifting quarters moved -4.03%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is inside what the company guided ('No further oil sales are expected in 2026'), so it is priced; residual risk is only headline optics for a retail-heavy register (Nordnet, Avanza, Saxo in the top 20).
findings.independence: Q3 production update does not mention a scheduled sale, unlike the Q3 2025 update which did: https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=656856

findings.finding: Brent fell from 117.64 (30 Oct) to 90.61 (19 Nov) and PNOR fell from 13.28 to 10.98 NOK over the same span, so the oil-price hit to the next lifting's value is already in the tape.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: not applicable: a macro move, not a results line
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: the stock's -17% from the 28 Oct high tracks Brent's -23%; it is filed so nobody re-sizes it as a negative surprise. Brent's own move on the day is the larger driver of the window than the release.

findings.finding: PetroNor is running a sale/farm-down process for its OML 113 (Aje) interest via Talanger Capital with several potential acquirers under NDA; the Q3 release will carry an update and could carry a transaction.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior OML 113 transaction announcement on a results day; the Feb 2026 interest increase was a separate release.
findings.why_not_priced: A completed deal would be news, but nothing has leaked since July; the likely update is 'ongoing', which is worth nothing, so only the small probability of a deal carries value.

Next entitlement lifting and any shareholder distribution tied to it, guided as not before 2027

baseline_tension: The lean (+0.51, all run-up) and the -10.3% 20-day run-up are an oil-price move, not a company signal; the findings are near zero and do not cut against either, while the name's results-day history leans mildly negative.
language_note: The filing channel is English-only for this issuer (all NewsWeb releases in English), and the Norwegian press carried nothing on PetroNor beyond the January 2026 indictment story (dn.no), which the English wires (Bloomberg Law, GIR, Investigate Europe) also carried: nothing the English sources did not already carry.
lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the pre-released production finding -0.2 -> -0.1 (only the preliminary September allocation is open) and the guided no-lifting finding -0.2 -> 0.0.
'Too small about the move' / reaction history moves p_up not abs_move: abs_move_pct 3.0 -> 3.3; the negative results-day habit stays in p_up 44 rather than shrinking the size.
